title: Lipid level predicted effector genes (Cadby et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays candidate causal genes for lipid levels from the study:

Comprehensive genetic analysis of the human lipidome identifies loci associated with lipid homeostasis with links to coronary artery disease.
Cadby G, Giles C, et al.
Nat Commun. 2022 Jun 6;13(1):3124. doi: 10.1038/s41467-022-30875-7.
PMID: 35668104

The authors quantified 596 serum lipid species, belonging to 33 lipid classes, in individuals of European ancestry. They then performed a discovery GWAS for lipid levels in the Busselton Health Study (BHS) cohort (4,492 individuals) and a discovery meta-analysis of the BHS cohort with 670 individuals from the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort and 895 individuals from the Australian Imaging, Biomarker, and Lifestyle (AIBL) cohort. Results may be explored at the authors' PheWeb data portal.

They then used the ProGeM framework (Stacey et al., 2019) to prioritize effector genes in lipid-associated genetic loci. The ProGeM approach includes a "top-down" component that prioritizes genes based on biological knowledge, and a "bottom-up" component that prioritizes genes based on genetically associated variants. Data types that were considered in the top-down component include:

  • location of the candidate gene within 500kb of the lead SNP
  • annotations to lipid-related phenotypes or pathway membership in the Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI), SwissLipids, LIPID MAPS Proteome Database (LMDP), Orphanet, or Reactome databases

Data types that were considered in the bottom-up component include:

  • whether a candidate gene is the nearest gene to the lead SNP
  • whether a lead SNP or its proxies are annotated by SNPEff as missense, start loss, stop gain, or high-impact for the gene
  • cis-eQTL data obtained from GTEx release 8 and eQTLGen release 2019-12-20
  • methylation QTL data obtained from the Huan et al., 2019 study
  • pQTL data obtained from SNiPA (Arnold et al., 2015) and Emilsson et al., 2018

    "tool tips": {
	"Locus number":"Number identifying an independent locus associated with lipid species/classes",
	"Lead SNP rsID":"Most significantly associated SNP within a locus",
	"Chromosome":"Chromosomal location of the lead SNP",
	"Position (hg19)":"Chromosomal coordinate of the lead SNP in the hg19 genome build",
	"Position (hg38)":"Chromosomal coordinate of the lead SNP in the GRCh38 genome build",
	"Effect allele":"Allele of the lead SNP with which lipid levels were measured",
	"Other allele":"Alternate allele of the lead SNP",
	"Lead SNP in BHS GWAS":"Whether the lead SNP was the most significantly associated SNP identified in BHS discovery GWAS results (linear mixed model), following clumping (R2<0.1)",
	"Lead SNP in discovery meta-analysis":"Whether the lead SNP was the most significantly associated SNP identified in the discovery IVW meta-analysis GWAS results from the BHS, ADNI, and AIBL cohorts, following clumping (r2<0.1)",
	"Previously identified mQTL":"Whether the lead SNP or its proxies were identified as metabolite QTLs in previous lipid or metabolite association studies",
	"Number of proxies (r2>0.8)":"Number of SNPs in LD with the lead SNP",
	"Most strongly associated lipid species":"Lipid that is most strongly associated with the lead SNP",
	"Association p-value":"p-value of the association between the lead SNP and the most strongly associated lipid species",
	"Dataset":"Whether the association was identified in the discovery analysis or meta-analysis or was conditional (a secondary signal identified in the BHS cohort)",
	"Lipid classes whose species are associated":"Classification(s) of the lipid species associated with the lead SNP",
	"Lead SNP CADD score":"Combined annotation dependent depletion (CADD) score from the SNiPA database for the lead SNP",
	"Proxy SNP CADD score":"The largest combined annotation dependent depletion (CADD) score from the SNiPA database for a proxy SNP",
	"Overlap of genetic-based and biological knowledge based candidates":"All genes obtained from proximity, protein consequences, eQTL, meQTL, and pQTL analysis and all protein coding genes within 500 kB present in curated databases of known metabolic pathways",
	"Lead genetic-based prioritization candidate":"Lead candidate gene predicted from proximity, protein consequences, and eQTL, meQTL, and pQTL analysis",
	"Ranked biological knowledge-based prioritization candidates":"Top three genes predicted from biological knowledge-based prioritization, ranked according to the number of times the gene was identified in curated databases",
	"ProGeM Expert annotations":"Prioritized gene based on ProGeM Expert analysis",
	"Nearest protein-coding genes":"Nearest protein-coding gene to the lead SNP",
	"Nearest protein-coding genes distance":"Distance between the nearest protein-coding gene and the lead SNP",
	"Variant consequences":"Consequences of the variant on coding sequences, predicted with SNPEff",
	"Cis-eQTL target protein coding genes":"Genes for which the lead SNP or its proxies were identified as expression QTLs",
	"meQTL target protein coding genes":"Genes for which the lead SNP or its proxies were identified as methylation QTLs",
	"pQTL target protein coding genes":"Genes for which the lead SNP or its proxies were identified as protein QTLs",
	"Protein-coding genes within 500kb of lead SNP":"All protein-coding genes within 500kb of the lead SNP",
	"Gene Ontology":"Genes within 500kb of the lead SNP that have lipid-related Gene Ontology annotations",
	"KEGG":"Genes within 500kb of the lead SNP that are annotated with membership in a lipid metabolic pathway in the KEGG database",
	"Mouse Genome Informatics":"Genes within 500kb of the lead SNP whose mouse orthologs are annotated as lipid-related in the Mouse Genome Informatics database",
	"Orphanet":"Genes within 500kb of the lead SNP that are annotated as lipid-related in the Orphanet database",
	"Reactome":"Genes within 500kb of the lead SNP that are annotated with membership in a lipid metabolic pathway in the Reactome database",
	"LMPD":"Genes within 500kb of the lead SNP that are annotated as lipid-related in the LMPD database",
	"SwissLipids":"Genes within 500kb of the lead SNP that are annotated as lipid-related in the SwissLipids database"
    },

dataTableLegendHtml:
• Click on a column header to sort the table by that column
  • Mouse over a column header to see more information about that column
  • Click the View button to see more evidence
  • Filter the table using the filters above:
    • enter a full or partial rsID, name of a lipid species, or name of a lipid class in the Lead SNP rsID, Lipid species, or Lipid classes filters, and hit "Return"
    • enter an upper threshold for p-value of the lead SNP's lipid association in the Association p-value filter, and hit Return
    • enter a full or partial gene name in the Gene filter and hit Return to retrieve all rows in which that gene name appears (in any column)
  • You may apply multiple filters.
